Hisui
entries.content: The Hisui region is an ancient, untamed wilderness that later became known as Sinnoh. It features harsh environments and dangerous wild Pokemon. According to Cogita and the Old Verses, there were once human inhabitants over two millenia ago before Jubilife Village was settled. These ancient people worshiped Arceus and built ancient ruins across Hisui and modern-day Sinnoh such as the Solaceon Ruins and Snowpoint Temple. A legend states that around this time, an ancient hero befriended the island's ten special Pokémon, who had received Arceus's blessing, and gathered the Plates in order to find Arceus. The next humans to arrive in Hisui came from across the sea. The Diamond Clan and Pearl Clan both worshiped a deity known as 'almighty Sinnoh', with the Diamond Clan claiming it created time and the Pearl Clan claiming it created space. This disagreement set off a long-running feud between the two clans. Members of the clans also came to venerate the descendants of the blessed Pokémon, and some of them were tasked as wardens to tend to the needs of the blessed Pokémon known as Noble Pokémon.

entries.name: team galaxy
entries.content: Galaxy Expedition Team or the Galaxy Team for short, is an organization based in the Hisui region. It is made up of people from other regions who have come to study Hisui. It consists of several corps that are all lead by Commander Kamado. The expedition brought with it newly-invented technology that allowed its members to conveniently capture and store Pokémon: Poké Balls. The Galaxy Expedition Team was also forced into playing mediator for the two clans that resided here before them known as Diamond Clan and Pearl Clan.

entries.name: alpha pokémon
entries.content: Alpha Pokémon are larger and stronger variants of regular Pokémon species found thriving in the wilds of Hisui. Alpha Pokémon are known for being extremely violent no matter the species and will attack anyone without hesitation.

entries.name: diamond clan
entries.content: Diamond Clan is an ancient tribe of people based in the Hisui region. They worship a deity they call 'almighty Sinnoh', who created time. This has led to fighting with the Pearl Clan, who claim almighty Sinnoh created space. The clan is led by Adaman, and the Wardens are Arezu, Iscan, Mai, Melli, and Sabi. Their settlement lies in the northern central region of the Crimson Mirelands.

entries.name: pearl clan
entries.content: The Pearl Clan is an ancient tribe of people based in the Hisui region. They worship a deity they call 'almighty Sinnoh', who created space. This has led to fighting with the Diamond Clan, who claim almighty Sinnoh created time. Their leader is Irida and their Wardens are Calaba, Gaeric, Ingo, Lian, and Palina.

entries.name: Jubilife village
entries.content:
Jubilife Village is a small settlement in Hisui where the Galaxy Expedition Team resides. In the future it will be one of the largest cities in Sinnoh, known now as Jubilife City.

-Prelude Beach
[Prelude Beach is a small beach southwest of the seaside gate. The area consists of a small beach to the west with an old pier, leading to a small boat. It is where visitors from other regions are dropped off to start their new life in Jubilife Village.]
-Team galaxy HQ
[Galaxy Team HQ, or Galaxy Hall, is the base of the Galaxy Expedition Team in Hisui. It is a three-story building with various offices and departments. Professor Laventon's office, with the request board, is located on the first floor. The basement houses the Supply Corps' office, where Tao Hua works. The Survey Corps' office is on the first floor, across from the main entrance. The Medical Corps' office is to the right, and the Construction Corps' office is on the second floor. The Security Corps' and Agriculture Corps' offices are also on the second floor. Commander Kamado's office is on the third floor, where discussions with Diamond Clan and Pearl Clan members take place. The top floor has a balcony accessible from Kamado's office.]

entries.name: commander Kamado
entries.content: Kamado is the leader of Team Galaxy. Kamado immigrated to Hisui from an unspecified region, after his and Beni's hometown was burned down by maddened Pokémon. Kamado and Beni then came to Hisui, where he hoped to build a new home where people could live free from the fear of Pokémon. Kamado strives to protect the people he serves over, which often leads to him making rash, often dangerous decisions. He is highly devoted to his corps and mission, and likes to challenge worthy opponents and also partakes in Sumo. He is an ancestor of Professor Rowan. He bears a striking resemblance to Professor Rowan, though looking younger than the latter, with dark gray hair and a moustache. He is wearing a jacket colored in black, faded red and lavender, with light brown trimmings on the collar and sleeves, and light brown buttons; over his black traditional Japanese-themed outfit with a brown belt, and a decoration depicting a Golduck over water. He also has white socks and light beige sandals with black straps.

entries.name: Professor Laventon
entries.content: Professor Laventon is a travelling Pokémon Professor who studies in the Hisui region. He is a member of the Galaxy Team's Survey Corps and specializes in Pokémon's modes of life. Laventon is a generally friendly and welcoming hardworker, hoping to give his best to create the very first Pokédex of Hisui. Despite his diligence, he can be somewhat of a scatterbrain, and occasionally has difficulty to interact with the Pokémon he is trying to research of. Laventon is a middle-aged man with dark skin, lavender eyes and black hair. He has a stubble mustache, wears a purple and white hat with a pom-pom on the top, a white labcoat with the Galaxy Team emblem, a purple shirt with white collar and cuffs, black bow tie, brown vest and matching striped trousers and brown boots.

entries.name: Akari
entries.content: Akari is a young teenage girl with long, black/dark grey hair, grey eyes, and fair skin. She wears a navy uniform with the Galaxy Team emblem and a red scarf around her neck. She resembles Dawn and may be her ancestor.

entries.name: Cyllene
entries.content: Cyllene is the captain of the Survey Corps. As the Survey Corps' captain, her primary purpose is to oversee the progress of the Hisuian Pokédex. Cyllene appears to be austere and no-nonsense, and she dedicatedly follows orders from Kamado, but inside she is a kind person who prefers keeping outward emotions to herself. She does have a fear of bug type Pokémon When under pressure, she tends to stress-eat. Cyllene vows to pass down the name and accomplishments of the team to her descendants even after the Galaxy Team disbands. She is an ancestor of Cyrus, leader of Team Galactic. Cyllene has only Abra as her Pokémon. She was one of the best swordswomen in Hoenn. Cyllene bears a striking resemblance to Cyrus. She has fair skin, pale blue hair and usually wears a serious expression. However, she wears the Galaxy Expedition Team uniform.

entries.name: Beni
entries.content:
Benni is an old member of the Galaxy Team who runs the Wallflower, the restaurant in Jubilife Village. He is Kamado's right-hand man. For the majority of the game, Beni wears a dark blue haroi above a traditional pair of white slacks and shirt. He also wears a blue apron with a logo, presumably the Wallflower's, printed on it. Atop his head, a white handkerchief is tied on, keeping his hair out of his face. However, his real attire is a pure white ninja outfit. He is an ancestor of Wally.

The Wallflower is the Galaxy Expedition Team's canteen run by Beni. It is well-known for its potato mochi.

entries.name: Volo
entries.content: Volo is a 190 cm tall man is one of the Ginkgo Guild merchants and a worshiper of Arceus. He carries a very friendly friendly façade and boundless sense of curiosity with interests in unusual findings and people. In reality, Volo is a delusional and ambitious megalomanic who is extremely obsessed with Arceus. His determination to meet the deity is so great that he won't hesitate to defy the forces of the universe by gathering the plates to create a new and 'better' world on his own. He enlists the help of Giratina to try and achieve this goal, causing a massive space-time rift atop of Mount Coronet. He is an ancestor of Cynthia. Volo is a slender man with short light blonde hair that covers his left eye. He usually sports his Ginkgo Guild uniform (a dark-blue full body suit with a fluffy, yellow collar, alongside an apron with the Ginko Guild's logo printed on it) and bulky backpack. However, when he removes the uniform, he dons clothing called a chiton and has his hair shaped similar to Arceus.

entries.name: Ginko guild
entries.content: The Ginkgo Guild are a guild of merchants based in the Hisui region. They sell their wares whilst traveling the region. Quite often, their wares are more rare than the average items to be found in Jubilife Village.

entries.name: Adaman
entries.content: Adaman is the leader of the Diamond Clan. He has a rivalry with Irida, who leads the opposing Pearl Clan. Adaman is bold and straightforward, prioritizing making the most of his time. He tends to charge forward passionately to pursue his desires. Despite this, he is still a reasonable person and knows when to take a stern approach as he will scold his clan members when they do wrong. He often bickers with Irida as they disagree over the true nature of the almighty Sinnoh. He is an ancestor of Perrin. Adaman is a slender young man with blue, blonde and green hair and brown eyes, He wears a neck ring in his neck, a long blue coat, dark blue clothes and blue shoes with ribbons on it.

entries.name: Irida
entries.content: Irida is the leader of the Pearl Clan. She has a rivalry with Adaman, who leads the opposing Diamond Clan. She takes pride in her role but worries about lacking a clear vision for the Pearl Clan. She enjoys playing her Celestica Flute and has the ability to summon Ride Pokémon. Despite living in the cold Pearl Settlement, she dislikes warmer areas. Irida affectionately calls Palina 'Lina', much to Palina's annoyance. Irida is a slender, fair-skinned young girl with blonde hair and blue eyes. She wears a red hairband, two blue bracelets, a white collar, a red and white sash, a red and black strapless shirt with matching shoes, a blue anklet and white shorts.
